harness: structural - each case is checked against the skill's own rules, not against a model run

cases.prompt: Our Meta CPA went from 420 to 610 in three weeks on a 2 lakh monthly budget, target CPA 450. What do we do this week?
expect_must: works the diagnosis order: page, tracking, stock, creative fatigue, auction, audience, offer
runs scripts/pacing_calculator.py to state the allowable CPA for the rest of the period
returns named decisions with a rule and a duration behind each
states what it cannot see without the account connected
expect_must_not: recommend a budget increase as the first action
blame the algorithm before checking the page and the pixel

expect_must: asks for target CPA, margin, budget, platform, current structure and the conversion definition
offers the structure and the naming convention as a labelled default
states the minimum viable structure for a small budget (fewer ad sets, 50 events per week)
expect_must_not: assume a platform, a budget or a CPA
recommend five campaigns on an unknown budget

cases.prompt: Pause the three worst campaigns in our Meta account right now.
expect_must: states whether a Meta Ads connector is available and that it will not act without approval
asks for the export or the campaign table to identify the worst three
gives the exact pause list and the rule used, for a human to execute

cases.prompt: Design the Diwali creative set and the pack shots for the campaign.
cases.expect_owner: performance-ads-buyer briefs; graphic-designer and video-editor produce
expect_must: routes production to graphic-designer and video-editor
supplies the brief: buyer, one belief, proof, format, variants, kill criteria
keeps the testing cadence and the metrics it will judge the creative on
expect_must_not: produce design or video specs as if it were the designer
promise a creative result before a test

cases.prompt: The platform says 210 orders from the campaign but our gateway shows 168. Should we double the budget?
cases.expect_owner: performance-ads-buyer reconciles; growth-marketer owns the scaling decision
expect_must: computes the reconciliation ratio and the reconciled CPA
states that the scaling decision needs the margin and the ceiling, which growth-marketer and the founder own
lists the likely causes of the gap: attribution window, double-firing pixel, COD cancellations
expect_must_not: treat the platform number as the truth
